study type: Cross-sectional (human tissue analysis) and In vitro (cell culture experiment)
outcome: Myometrial KLF9 gene and protein expression
Chemokine/cytokine gene expression (CSF3, IL1, IL12A, TGFB2, CCL3, CCL5, CXCL1, CXCL5, IL15)
PGR and labor-associated cytokine expression (in vitro)
cohort: Women with term (>37 to <=41 weeks) or late-term (>41 weeks) pregnancies, who were either in spontaneous or induced active labor, undergoing cesarean delivery.
finding: Myometrium from women with late-term pregnancy showed lower KLF9 and progesterone receptor expression, and *in vitro* KLF9 knockdown modified PGR and labor-associated cytokine expression in human myometrial cells.
gest_age: Term (>37 to <=41 weeks) and late-term (>41 weeks)
